messages:
sara_johnson: @support trying to apply promo code SPRINGTRIAL2025 on our org (org_82a1). Dashboard gives "Promo code invalid or expired". Screenshot: [screenshot-1.png]

alex_k: hey! can you paste the org ID (looks like you already did), and confirm whether you used the dashboard or the API? any exact error text helps.

sara_johnson: org_82a1, used dashboard -> Billing -> Apply promo. Also tried the API and got a 400. Response: ```{
  "error": "code_invalid",
  "message": "Promo code invalid or expired"
}```

alex_k: thanks. holding while I check the admin console for that code.

alex_k: quick lookup: SPRINGTRIAL2025 -> promo_id promo_9f3a, status=active, redeemed_count=0, expiry=2026-02-28. That expiry looks wrong (marketing said 2026-06-30). Escalating to billing: @michael_billing can you confirm?

michael_billing: looking. give me a sec. Is org_82a1 the one to grant if we need a workaround?

alex_k: yes, sara is on org_82a1.

michael_billing: I see the promo TTL was set incorrectly in the promo catalog (manual entry). Redeemed_count=0 but expiry is in the past, so dashboard/API treats it as expired. I can do a one-time manual credit grant while we update the catalog. Running internal grant:```bash
billing_cli grant-credits --org org_82a1 --amount 2000 --reason "promo manual override" --issued_by michael_billing
```

billing_bot: Command queued: id=tx_33444 status=processing

billing_bot: Command complete: id=tx_33444 status=success. org_82a1 balance:+2000 credits.

alex_k: sara, please refresh the billing page and check Credits balance. The promo code may still show as expired but you should have the one-time credits now.

sara_johnson: refreshed — I can see +2000 credits under Billing > Credits. Thank you!! :tada: The promo code still shows invalid on the apply form though.

michael_billing: noted. I'll file INT ticket and update the promo catalog expiry to 2026-06-30 and invalidate the old entry. Filing ticket INT-5234 (promo catalog TTL mismatch). Also adding a postmortem note so marketing doesn't publish wrong TTLs.

alex_k: thanks @michael_billing. Sara — do you want us to re-send an updated promo code or keep the manual credits?

sara_johnson: manual credits are fine for now, thank you. Could we get confirmation when the catalog entry is fixed so other users won't hit this?

michael_billing: will follow up in the ticket and ping this thread once fixed.

alex_k: great — marking this resolved from support side. If anything else pops up, reopen the thread or DM. :white_check_mark:

sara_johnson: all good, appreciate the quick help :pray:
